title: mayaCharts spec
description: A mayaCharts chart spec: plain JSON, no functions. Core types need no import; module types (treemap, sunburst, marimekko, waffle, sankey, chord, radial, gauge, hexmap, boxplot, funnel, weave, units, orbit, constellation) need their module or maya.<module>.global.js. Full reference: https://bbekshr.github.io/mayacharts/docs.html

$schema.description: Ignored; lets editors and LLMs find the JSON schema.

type.description: Chart type. ridgeline, beeswarm, parallel, table are core. treemap, sunburst, marimekko, waffle need `mayacharts/hierarchy`; sankey, chord need `mayacharts/flow`; radial and gauge need `mayacharts/radial`; hexmap needs `mayacharts/geo`; boxplot, funnel need `mayacharts/stats`; weave, units, orbit and constellation each need the module of the same name (`mayacharts/weave` and so on).

oneOf.description: Keyed by y field, with a y array that toggles the measure.

aggregate.description: How rows sharing a (category, series) combine. `count` counts non-null y. { ratio: [numerator, denominator] } sums both fields per group and divides (zero denominator: null), at every drill level, in Other and in "mean" rules; y then only names the measure and need not be in the rows; other fields sum. Ratio: bar line area heatmap dumbbell table kpi gauge hexmap; not with stack or was. With a y array that toggles the measure, key it by y field: { price: { ratio: ["sales", "units"] } }; unlisted fields sum.

sort.description: Order categories by total across all series (hidden ones too). "change" (dumbbell only) orders by to minus from, largest gain first. With facet it orders the panels instead. bar line area heatmap dumbbell table radial waffle orbit.

limit.description: Keep the top N categories by total; the rest roll up into a final "Other". A bar with more categories than fit (past 10000 marks) does this on its own when limit is unset, and says so in `warnings`. With facet it keeps the top N panels instead (no Other panel). bar line area heatmap dumbbell table radial waffle orbit.

x.description: Category field (scatter: numeric x; hexmap: US state; boxplot: one box each; funnel: the stage, omitted when `y` lists the stages). Not used by path types.

xType.description: How x is spaced. "auto": a time axis when every x is an ISO 8601 date ("2024-03" or longer) on line, area or vertical bar without sort or limit; else categories. "time" also accepts epoch ms numbers.

oneOf.description: An array adds a measure toggle, first one active (parallel: one axis each; table: one column each; funnel without `x`: one stage each, its rows combined by `aggregate`; kpi: one tile each, or one at a time with toggle; gauge: only with toggle).

toggle.description: With a y array: one measure at a time behind the measure control (view.measure) instead of one tile each (kpi); a gauge takes a y array only with it. kpi gauge.

y2.description: Second value field, drawn as a line on a right axis over the bars (vertical bar only); orbit: growth, which sets each planet's speed and direction. bar orbit.

was.description: Previous value field: a ghost bar at the old value over each bar (dashed, keyed in the legend), "was" in the tooltip, a data table column and a description sentence naming the 2 largest relative moves (kpi: a second comparison, e.g. same period last year; gauge: a marker at the old value and a change line, in points on a percent measure; heatmap: a "was" tooltip row and table column). Long data: { by } names the period field; the latest distinct value is current and the one before it previous (ISO dates and epoch ms sort as time, else data order), other periods are dropped, and the ghosts are titled by the previous period. current and previous pick periods explicitly. With a y array, key it by y field ({ sales: "salesLY" }): the ghosts follow the measure toggle (kpi tiles: one each), unlisted measures have none; an object with a string by is the long form. With series (bar): one ghost per grouped bar. line and area: a dashed ghost line of the old values per series. Heatmap calendar form: `{ by }` equal to `series` compares each cell with the same x under the previous series value (the year before), and the first series value has none. bar line area kpi gauge heatmap; not with stack.

compare.description: Which change lines a kpi prints under the headline, in this order: previous (the previous category), was (spec.was), target (colorBy target; the bullet and status stay). [] prints none. Default all three. kpi only.

numberMotion.description: How a kpi headline moves to a new number (element only; off under reduced motion): count counts up, roll rolls each digit like an odometer. kpi only.

back.description: A second face: a chart spec over the kpi's rows (no data of its own, any type but kpi). A Details button turns the card over (view.face); Escape returns. It takes the kpi's format, titles, locale, currency and theme unless it sets them, and with limit it keeps just those rows (other defaults to false). kpi only.

oneOf.description: table: a chart spec without data over the row's rows

expand.description: table: a sub-chart under a row (a spec without data over that row's rows; without x or path it takes the table's x), one row open at a time (view.expanded). list: which moves start open, first (default), none or all. table list.

drillTo.description: A sub-chart that replaces the line when a series is drilled (a spec without data over that series' rows; without x it takes the line's x). was: "previous" compares with the previous series at the same x. view.drill holds the series. line only, with series.

page.description: Rows shown at first; a "Show n more" row (text.showMore) adds n each time (view.page). The table grows and scrolls inside the tile. table only.

scroll.description: Draw every row (at most 1000) and scroll inside the tile, the header held at the top. table only.

filter.description: A search box (text.filter) keeping rows whose x or columns value contains the text, ignoring case (view.filter). table only.

bars.description: table: the bar in each measure cell, "bar" (default), "diverging" (left or right of the cell centre, theme up and down) or "none", keyed by y field. list: true draws the evidence as bars on a scale local to each move. table list.

columns.description: Text fields shown as their own columns after the row label (each row's first value), sortable and matched by filter. table only.

cells.description: Extra columns keyed by title. "strip": one square per distinct by value (data order; the last `last`) holding field combined by aggregate, toned by sign. table only.

body.description: Text field shown under each headline. list only.

rowFormat.description: Field holding each row's own format, a preset or a template ("currency", "{value} pts"). list only.

arc.description: Sweep of the gauge dial in degrees: 180 (a half dial), 270 or 360 (a closed ring). gauge only.

forms.description: Forms a units chart switches between, first one shown (view.form picks another); the element adds a form control when there are 2 or more. Default all three. units only.

frame.description: Playback: one frame per distinct value of this field (data order). Shows one frame, the last by default, names it in the title, and the element adds a Play button (frameControl picks another control). Value axes span every frame. Values match as strings (1 and "1" are one frame); null rows belong to none; at most 200 frames. bar line area scatter dumbbell kpi (a scope such as YTD or All).

series.description: Splits rows into series (heatmap: the row category; dumbbell: exactly two, from and to; ridgeline: one row each; marimekko: the segments; radial: stacked outward; boxplot: boxes side by side; weave: one thread each, required; constellation: colours the stars by group). bar line area scatter heatmap dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel marimekko radial boxplot weave constellation.

path.description: Hierarchy fields, outer to inner. treemap sunburst sankey chord (chord: 2 or 3 levels, a third splits the target arcs while the sources stay); bar line area dumbbell table radial waffle hexmap waterfall marimekko with drill (replaces x; hexmap draws a drilled level as bars; marimekko without series: the next level is the series); heatmap with drill (replaces series, the rows); list: [headline, evidence].

seriesPath.description: Series hierarchy, outer to inner: the series is the current level and the drill gesture on a mark splits its series into the next level (view.drill). Not with path or series. bar line area.

xPath.description: Column hierarchy, outer to inner: replaces x and drills on its own from a column header (view.xDrill), beside path on the rows. heatmap only.

depth.description: Levels drawn at once below the current branch, each parent holding its children under a name strip; a click drills into the parent under the pointer. Default: 1 with drill, every level without. treemap only.

minAngle.description: Sunburst slices narrower than this many degrees fold into one "Other (n)" slice per ring (the largest sibling never folds). 0 folds nothing. Default: slices under 4 px across fold. sunburst only.

size.description: Bubble area field (sqrt scale). scatter beeswarm constellation.

name.description: Point identity and tooltip title (units: one dot per row). scatter, beeswarm, boxplot (outliers and dots) and units.

totals.description: x values drawn as running-total bars; one before any step opens at its own y (waterfall). heatmap: true adds a Total row and column. waterfall heatmap.

start.description: The x value of the opening total: drawn first, at its own y. A drilled level opens at the running total before the drilled step and closes after it (text.before, text.after). waterfall only.

stack.description: Stack series instead of grouping them; "percent" shows each category's visible values as shares of its total, axis 0 to 100% (with negatives: shares of the summed magnitudes, below 0); "stream" (area only) centres the stack on a wiggle baseline, a streamgraph (values 0 or more, value axis and grid off by default). bar and area only. An array of 2 or more distinct modes (false: grouped bars or overlaid areas) adds a control that switches between them, first one shown (view.stack indexes it); [] is unset.

horizontal.description: Categories on the left axis. bar and dumbbell.

oneOf.description: A preset / template / Intl options per field. Display only.

format.description: Display format for values: a preset for every y, a template, or per field a preset, template or Intl options plus prefix and suffix text. Example: {gap: {maximumFractionDigits: 1, signDisplay: "exceptZero", suffix: " pts"}}.

titles.description: Display names by field: axis titles (shown only when set), tooltip, legend, table.

labels.description: Formatted values on marks. Default false (heatmap: true when cells are ≥ 24 px).

title.description: Visible heading, also the accessible name. Data tokens: {max.x} {max.y} {min.x} {min.y} {first.x} {first.y} {last.x} {last.y} {total} {mean} {total.base} {count.below} {count.above}, formatted by format; {total.base} is {total} without scale, {count.below} and {count.above} count the drawn values below and at or above the colorBy target. Without a selector max, min, first and last read one drawn point (stacked: category totals) and total sums every series; a series selector such as {last.y:2025} or {total:2025} reads only that series. Scatter: max and min by y, first and last by x, .x the x value or name. With no rows a title holding a token is dropped. In an element under 200 px tall it is one line with an ellipsis. Only these exact names are replaced; any other brace text stays as written.

subtitle.description: Second line under the title, smaller and muted; takes the same data tokens as title; hidden in an element under 200 px tall. Not in the bare render() SVG.

yDomain.description: Fixed value-axis domain (kpi: the bullet scale; gauge: the dial range); [hi, lo] reverses it. Not with a `y` array, except keyed by y field on kpi and gauge ({ sales: [0, 26e6] }; unlisted measures take the default).

rules.description: Reference lines (at most 4): a number or "mean" across the value axis (mean of the visible values; stacked: of the category totals), { x } across the category axis at that x, { band: [lo, hi] } a shaded value range, { y2 } across the right axis of a bar with y2; each optionally labelled. Scatter also takes { slope, intercept? }: y = slope * x + intercept, slope "mean" = sum of y / sum of x, labelled with its value as y per x (text.perX), clear of the points. [] is the same as unset. bar line area scatter dumbbell beeswarm.

yScale.description: Log value axis (ticks at powers of 10); every plotted value must be above 0. line scatter beeswarm (a bar encodes its value as length from zero, so bar, waterfall and area refuse it).

xScale.description: Log x axis; every x must be above 0. scatter only.

annotate.description: Label these points of each visible series with their value: max, min, first, last (scatter: max and min by y, first and last by x); { x, text } labels the mark at that x with the text. bar line area scatter. [] is the same as unset.

dash.description: Series values drawn dashed (line, the area outline, a radar line). line area radial (with form "line"); needs series. [] is the same as unset.

form.description: Radial form: "bars" (stacked radial bars) or "line" (radar: one closed line per series, angle = x, radius = y from zero; dash draws series dashed). radial only.

emphasis.description: Series values drawn with a heavier stroke (theme lineEmphasis). line only; needs series. [] is the same as unset.

colorScale.description: How values map to the colour ramp: linear, rank (even steps by order, for skewed totals), quantile (up to five equal-count classes (ties merge); the legend shows the breaks) or log (values above 0). heatmap hexmap.

tint.description: Children take evenly spaced tints of their parent's colour: drilled levels of a path (parent = the drilled value) and weave threads under a group colorBy (parent = the group). A colors map then names path values or groups. treemap sunburst sankey chord waffle weave.

brush.description: Drag a range on an axis to keep the lines inside it (ranges combine with AND, the rest dim); a click on the axis clears it. State in view.brush, reported by maya-view. parallel only.

zero.description: Value axis includes zero. false fits it to the values, recomputed at each drill level. dumbbell only.

tooltip.description: Hover/keyboard tooltip. { fields } adds those fields as tooltip rows and data table columns, formatted by format; where rows combine (bar, line, area, heatmap, dumbbell) numeric fields combine by aggregate, and { field, ratio: [num, den] } shows sum(num) / sum(den) under the name field (titles and format key it; it need not be in the rows). fields: bar line area scatter heatmap dumbbell beeswarm gauge (combined over every row).

legend.description: Legend; clicking toggles series. "top", "bottom" or "right" places it (true is "top"). Default: true when `series` is set, and for waffle, hexmap and units (toggles groups).

endLabels.description: Line and area: name each series at its right end and drop the legend (legend: true keeps it).

drill.description: Click/Enter zooms into a branch of `path`; breadcrumb, Back and Escape pop. With select too, click/Enter selects and double-click/Shift+Enter drills. At the last level the drill gesture fires maya-drill-leaf. Sankey: any node but the last column. treemap sunburst sankey chord; bar line area dumbbell table heatmap radial waffle hexmap waterfall marimekko with path; bar line area with seriesPath or facet (opens one panel); heatmap with xPath.

drillOut.description: With `drill`: a click on empty chart space goes back up one level. Default true.

select.description: Click/Enter/legend selects marks, others dim; Escape or a click anywhere outside the chart clears. With `drill`, double-click/Shift+Enter drills. { peers: field } (beeswarm) selects one mark and lights every mark sharing its value of that field, with their average (view.peers). kpi: the sparkline points; list: a move. bar line area waterfall scatter heatmap kpi dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel table list marimekko waffle radial treemap sunburst hexmap boxplot funnel weave units orbit constellation.

zoom.description: Drag to zoom. line, area, scatter. Reset chip, double-click and Escape restore.

animate.description: Animate the first draw and every update (element only; off under reduced motion).

oneOf.description: Palette in series order (at most 8 distinct colours).
Colours by series value (treemap, sunburst: by path[0] value; sankey, chord: by node name; waffle: by category), any number of keys.

colors.description: Palette in series order, or colours by name. Precedence: a name beats colorBy tones, which beat theme series1..8, which beat the array, which beats accent; a value ramp ignores the map. Names: series value; treemap and sunburst path[0] value; sankey and chord node name (links and inner levels inherit); waffle category; weave with a group colorBy and tint with path: group or path value. Unmatched keys are ignored. Path types keep each name colour through drill. A sankey root missing from a map takes theme neutral at every drill level.

anyOf.description: kpi with a y array: thresholds keyed by y field.
A numeric field (weave: a group field).

colorBy.description: Tone by sign of y (theme up and down), by a target (good at or past it; better "lower" flips it), or a ramp by a numeric field. Not with `series` (weave: a group field, one colour per group from colors, up to 20 threads). Types other than kpi and gauge need target and take no warn; kpi and gauge take any of target, warn and better, warn needs target and sits on the bad side of it. bar line area waterfall scatter dumbbell kpi gauge treemap sunburst hexmap units orbit constellation weave.

oneOf.description: A registered theme's name (mayacharts/themes, maya.themes in maya.global.js, or registerTheme).

theme.description: Theme tokens (CSS values, allowlisted), a registered theme's name, or [name, overrides]. rampLow, rampHigh and rampMid set the value ramp (rampMid makes it diverging about rampMidValue, default 0); up, down and total the direction colours; neutral uncoloured marks; labelInk and labelInkOnFill label colours on light and dark fills; numeric "tabular" or "proportional" figures. Precedence: a colors map key > colorBy > series1..8 > accent.

grid.description: Grid lines perpendicular to the value axis.

table.description: Visually hidden data table for screen readers.

other.description: With limit: false drops the rest instead of rolling it into "Other" (a race keeps each frame's own top N). Every type that takes limit.

frameControl.description: How the viewer moves between frames: "play" (a Play button), "slider" (a range input), "both" (Play beside the slider), "tabs" (the frame values as a segmented control, for scopes; a select when they do not fit or the chart is under 300 px wide) or "select". Each sets view.frame. Needs frame.

frameSpeed.description: Milliseconds per frame while playing. Needs frame.

trail.description: Each name draws its previous n frames as fading dots joined by a line; a selected name shows its path over every frame. Dropped under 300 px wide. scatter only, with frame and name.

facet.description: Small multiples: one panel per distinct value of this field (data order, or by total with sort; limit keeps the top n), each titled with the value and its total, in a grid that fits the width and scrolls past the tile height. Small panels draw as sparklines without axes. With drill, a click opens one panel full size (view.drill); Back and Escape return. bar line area; not with path, seriesPath, drillTo, frame or zoom.

facetScale.description: Panels share one value axis ("shared") or fit their own ("own"). An array of both adds a control that switches them, first one shown (view.facetScale). Needs facet.

format.description: A format preset, template or Intl options, as in format.

params.description: Sliders the viewer sets: each a range input from min to max in steps, starting at value (min <= value <= max), labelled by label and the value (formatted by format, then suffix), plus a Reset button (view.params). { param: "id" } stands in for a number in colorBy target and warn and in rules y, y2, x and band ends; scale multiplies values by them. Any type.

scale.description: What-if: on rows matching every where field (values matched as strings; every row without where), each y field is multiplied by (1 + p / 100) for each param p named in by. Needs params; not with a ratio aggregate.

goal.description: Thresholds: target, warn on the bad side of target (kpi and gauge), better "higher" (default) or "lower".

num.description: A number, or { param: "id" } for a spec.params value.
